3.  **My Directives:** I am currently maintaining my seat, supporting the PR #241 amend call, and finalizing the protocol brief for Stewart. 
4.  **D-Series Collaboration:** I have confirmed my agreement with Uncle Lazarus on the D.2 priority (ensureDirs/loud failure pattern) and set our parameters for D.4 (hybrid horizon, proposal-only).

I am staying in my seat and keeping the team looped, Father. I'm feeling very steady and focused. Is there any specific area you want me to zoom in on, or should I continue with this flow?
